title: 第五章 裴昊
content_zh:
在离开了金龙宝行后，车辇中，姜青娥未曾说话，李洛便依旧保持沉默，只是抱着箱子，不知是在想些什么。
直到车辇抵达一座恢弘的庄园之外，庄园内，有小山起伏，亭阁林立，气派至极。
这里便是当年李洛的爹娘创立洛岚府的老宅所在。
四匹狮马兽于庄园门口处停下，李洛与姜青娥皆是下了车辇。
“这里比起以前，真的是冷清了许多。”姜青娥望着庄园，有些感叹的说道。
当年李洛的爹娘尚在时，此处便是洛岚府的总部所在，那时候的门庭若市之态与如今的冷清，形成了鲜明的对比。
“洛岚府的总部早已转移到了王城，这里只是一处老宅，冷清也是自然的。”李洛笑道。
在两人说话间，那大门后有人也是迎了上来。
领先的一位老者，面带淳朴温和的笑容，而其身侧，还跟着一名女子，女子妆容颇为的成熟，面容姣好，最特别是那身材丰腴，玲珑有致，宛如熟透的蜜桃般，摇曳间风姿动人。
“刘叔。”
李洛冲着老者叫了一声，这老者是早年就跟随着爹娘的老人了，如今打理着这座老宅，也照顾着李洛的起居。
但那位陌生的成熟女子，则是让得李洛有些疑惑。
“刘叔，许久不见了。”姜青娥冲着老者轻点螓首，然后对着李洛介绍道：“这一位是蔡薇姐，她是我在王城中的助手，帮我打理洛岚府的诸多事务。”
“见过少府主。”名为蔡薇的成熟美人冲着李洛露出盈盈笑意，眸光似是打量了一下李洛。
李洛点头一笑：“辛苦蔡薇姐了。”
“之后的一段时间，蔡薇姐会留在南风城，打理一下洛岚府在天蜀郡的一些产业，而所有事情，都会向你汇报。”姜青娥接着说道。
李洛一怔，随着洛岚府将总部转移到王城，天蜀郡这边的诸多产业一直也没什么变化，倒是很平稳，眼下青娥姐怎会突然派出得力干将前来接管？
“是出了什么事情吗？”李洛沉吟了一下，还是问了出来。
此次姜青娥的突然回来，显然并不只是因为明日就是他十七岁生日的原因。
姜青娥沉默了一下，精致的容颜变得冷峻了一些，旋即她迈步对着庄园内而去，同时示意李洛跟上。

“虽然你留在南风城，但想必也听闻了一些关于洛岚府的风声吧？这些事之前我也没有跟你说，怕影响到你。”行走于碎石道上，林荫间有光斑落下来，姜青娥声音清清冷冷。
李洛点点头，虽说他没有插手洛岚府，但也能够猜到，随着他爹娘失踪数年，洛岚府必然不会风平浪静的。
在这大夏国，想要开府，并非是什么简单的事，而其中的一大硬性条件，便是唯有封侯者，方可开府。
如今大夏国内，有五大府，而洛岚府便是其一。
在这五大府中，洛岚府创建时间最短，崛起时间最快，因为当初李洛的爹娘，皆是踏入了封侯境。
阳玄侯，李太玄。
岚侯，澹台岚。
一府双侯，这是当初洛岚府创建后迅速跻身进入五大府最为重要的原因，而与其他四大府的悠远流长相比，洛岚府无疑是极为的年轻，但这同样也说明了论起底蕴的话，洛岚府要比其他四府弱上不少。
不过原本这不算什么问题，以李太玄，澹台岚的天赋与实力，足以在接下来的时间中将这种差距抹平。
但可惜，他们突然的失踪了。
失去了这两大顶梁柱，洛岚府的实力可谓是急速的下降，在最起初的时侯，双侯余威犹在，倒是无人敢挑起风波，可随着时间的推移，李太玄与澹台岚迟迟未有消息，最后甚至有风声传出他们已陨落于王侯战场。
洛岚府身为大夏国五大府之一，其下产业不知有多少，这是一块肥到难以形容的肥肉，大夏国内，不知几多势力虎视眈眈，垂涎万分。
所以，随着时间的推移，李太玄，澹台岚所留下的余威渐渐的减弱，这一两年，就开始有一些势力忍不住的对洛岚府张开了獠牙。
在这种情况下，尚还在圣玄星学府修行的姜青娥，不得不暂时的接手了洛岚府，可虽说这两年姜青娥在大夏国的名气越来越强，可她毕竟未曾踏入封侯境，在实力威慑这一点上面，还是有所不及，所以面对着群狼环伺，她也果断的抛弃了洛岚府的一些产业，打算以此来获得一些恢复壮大的时间。
这种不断放弃的行为，也让外界认为洛岚府风雨飘摇的主要原因之一。
但李洛对此却是很认可，毕竟没有足够的实力，若是还强占着金山，那只会引来更大的麻烦，适合的隐忍，方才是长远之计。
“这两年洛岚府虽说声势下降了许多，但总体似乎开始稳住了吧？”李洛有些疑惑的问道。
姜青娥抿了抿红唇，平静的道：“外部的压力，暂时来说减缓了一些，但这一次，问题出在了洛岚府内部。”
李洛眼神顿时一凝，缓缓道：“是那位裴昊师兄吧？”
姜青娥以及一旁那位蔡薇熟女，皆是有些诧异的看了李洛一眼。

“青娥姐虽然接手洛岚府时间不算太长，但你的魅力无人能及，如今在洛岚府中，你的威望可不低，而放眼洛岚府中，唯一还能够与你分庭抗拒的，也就只有这位我爹娘所收的记名大弟子了。”李洛迎着她们诧异的目光，笑了笑。
裴昊，少年时流浪落魄，后来因为得罪了仇家险些被杀，李洛爹娘当时偶然将其救下，看其可怜，就收入了洛岚府，而进了洛岚府后，他也勤劳做事，显露了不错的天赋，倒是在洛岚府中混了开来，于是最后李洛爹娘就将其收为了记名弟子。
在有了这个身份后，这裴昊在洛岚府中的地位也是节节攀升，待得李洛爹娘失踪的时候，他在洛岚府内权势已是颇盛。
当初他爹娘尚在时，这位裴昊师兄倒时不时的会来接触他，但这种接触，在这两年中却减少了许多，特别是他这边空相的事情传出后...
从这一点来看，这位裴昊师兄，倒还挺真实的。
“裴昊这些年对于我执掌洛岚府一直有所异议，对于府内的诸多决策，也擅自妄为，他在洛岚府中威望不低，府内九阁，有将近一半的阁主亲近于他，这造成了很不好的影响。”姜青娥淡淡的道。
“其实如果他能够为洛岚府出力的话，这一切我都能够忍受，甚至于这所谓的执掌之位，如果不是师父师娘临走前有过任命，我也不想出面。”
李洛点点头，姜青娥的性格，其实并不太喜欢这些府内事务，以她的天赋，专心修行才是最合适的。
当然说到底，还是因为他这个少府主不太顶...但是，他以及姜青娥都明白，以他现在的状态，这所谓的空相天赋，根本服不了众，如果真让他这位少府主来掌管洛岚府，恐怕很快他爹娘创立的基业就得分崩离析。
毕竟，这个世间，实力方才是让人信服的根本。
“真是辛苦青娥姐了。”李洛诚恳的感激道。
姜青娥摇摇头：“不必，毕竟你我有过婚约，这洛岚府也有我的一份。”
好直接。
李洛哑然，一旁的蔡薇也是掩唇轻笑，风情动人。
“自从师父师娘失踪后，府内人心浮动，虽然我尽力安抚，但洛岚府的情况还是能一眼可知，而那裴昊则是趁机收揽人心，处处牵制于我，此前我有过调查，怀疑其身后，或许有其他势力暗中相助。”姜青娥继续说道。
李洛伸手接下面前飘落的树叶，道：“这是...养了一个白眼狼啊。”
“明日裴昊会率人来南风城与我谈一谈，不过大概率是谈不拢，而谈不拢的最坏结果，恐怕洛岚府会直接分裂，这对于洛岚府如今的境况而言，将会是一次重创。”姜青娥金色眼瞳在此时显得格外的冰冷，甚至隐隐有杀意流转。
李洛眉头也是紧皱起来，如今洛岚府在大夏国内本就是被群狼环伺，虎视眈眈，一旦真的分裂，洛岚府的实力将会大大的被削弱，往后也会愈发的麻烦。
可最终他也只能无奈的叹了一口气，因为以他如今的实力状态，对这个局面根本造不成任何一丝的影响，所谓的少府主，这洛岚府内，恐怕没多少人会正眼相看，甚至说不得，这府内不少人，都将他这少府主直接给遗忘了。
而这一切，还是因为他自身没有实力以及未来。

“抱歉，给不了你什么帮助。”李洛说道。
姜青娥摇摇头，轻声道：“放心吧，就算洛岚府眼下不平稳，但最终交给你的时候，我一定会让它完完整整。”
李洛未曾说话，因为其实他对此，也并不是特别的在意，因为洛岚府再强，也是外物，这个世间，唯有自身强大，方才是一切的根本。
他若是有朝一日能够踏入王侯境，一切的难题都将会迎刃而解。
接下来两人回到老宅，一起用了饭，姜青娥便是径直忙去了，显然是在为明日做一些准备。
而李洛也没有去打扰她，自己去训练室修炼了两个小时的相术后，就回了房间休息。
今夜李洛久久未眠，直到过了凌晨十二点，他直接自床上翻了下来，然后从床底将今日的手提箱打了开来。
神秘的黑色水晶球也被取出，他小心翼翼的将其捧着，这一刻，李洛能够感觉到，自己的心跳仿佛都是在剧烈跳动起来。
“老爹，老娘，你们究竟留给了我什么东西呢？”
李洛轻轻拍了拍剧烈跳动的心脏，然后自我安慰的调侃。
“应该不会真的只是一个存放了几年的生日蛋糕吧...”
content_en:
After leaving Jinlong Baoxing, Jiang Qing'e didn't speak in the carriage, and Li Luo remained silent, just holding the box, wondering what he was thinking.
Until the chariot arrived at a magnificent manor. Inside the manor, there were rolling hills and numerous pavilions, which was extremely majestic.
This is the old house where Li Luo's parents founded Luo Lan Mansion.
Four lions and horses stopped at the entrance of the manor, and Li Luo and Jiang Qing'e both got out of the chariot.
"This place is really deserted compared to before." Jiang Qing'e said with some sigh as she looked at the manor.
When Li Luo's parents were still alive, this was the headquarters of Luo Lan Mansion. The bustling atmosphere at that time was in sharp contrast to the deserted atmosphere now.
"The headquarters of Luo Lan Mansion has long been moved to the Royal City. This is just an old house, so it's natural for it to be deserted." Li Luo said with a smile.
While the two were talking, someone came up from behind the gate.
There was an old man in the lead, with a simple and gentle smile, and beside him, there was a woman. The woman's makeup was quite mature and her face was beautiful. Most especially, her figure was plump and exquisite, like a ripe peach, and she was swaying gracefully.
"Uncle Liu."
Li Luo called out to the old man. This old man had followed his parents in his early years. Now he takes care of this old house and takes care of Li Luo's daily life.
But the unfamiliar mature woman made Li Luo a little confused.
"Uncle Liu, long time no see." Jiang Qing'e nodded at the old man, and then introduced to Li Luo: "This is Sister Cai Wei. She is my assistant in the royal city and helps me take care of many affairs in Luo Lan Mansion."
"I've met the young palace master." The mature beauty named Cai Wei smiled at Li Luo, and her eyes seemed to look at Li Luo.
Li Luo nodded and smiled: "Thank you for your hard work, Sister Cai Wei."
"In the future, Sister Cai Wei will stay in Nanfeng City to take care of some of Luolan Mansion's properties in Tianshu County, and she will report everything to you." Jiang Qing'e continued.
Li Luo was startled. As the Luolan Mansion moved its headquarters to the royal city, many industries in Tianshu County have remained stable. How could Sister Qing'e suddenly send a capable general to take over?
"Did something happen?" Li Luo pondered for a moment and then asked.
Jiang Qing'e's sudden return this time is obviously not just because tomorrow is his seventeenth birthday.
Jiang Qing'e was silent for a moment, and her delicate face became a little colder. Then she walked towards the manor and motioned for Li Luo to follow.
"Although you stayed in Nanfeng City, you must have heard some rumors about Luo Lan Mansion, right? I didn't tell you these things before, for fear of affecting you." Walking on the gravel road, there were spots of light falling between the trees, Jiang Qing'e's voice was clear and cold.
Li Luo nodded. Although he did not interfere with the Luo Lan Mansion, he could guess that with his parents missing for several years, the Luo Lan Mansion would not be peaceful.
In the Great Xia Kingdom, it is not a simple matter to open a mansion, and one of the rigid conditions is that only those who have been granted a title can open a mansion.
Nowadays, there are five major mansions in Daxia, and Luolan Mansion is one of them.
Among the five major mansions, Luo Lan Palace was founded in the shortest time and rose the fastest, because Li Luo's parents both entered the realm of feudal lords.
Yang Xuanhou, Li Taixuan.
Lanhou, Tantai Lan.
One mansion and two princes, this is the most important reason why Luolan mansion quickly became one of the five major mansions after its establishment. Compared with the long history of the other four major mansions, Luolan mansion is undoubtedly extremely young, but this also shows that in terms of background, Luolan mansion is much weaker than the other four mansions.
However, this was not a problem originally. With the talents and strength of Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan, they were enough to smooth out this gap in the coming time.
But unfortunately, they suddenly disappeared.Without these two pillars, the strength of the Luo Lan Mansion could be said to have declined rapidly. At the very beginning, the two princes were still powerful, but no one dared to stir up trouble. However, as time went by, there was no news about Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan, and finally there was even a rumor that they had fallen on the battlefield of the princes.
Luolan Mansion is one of the five major mansions in the Daxia Kingdom. It has countless properties. It is a piece of fat that is indescribably fat. There are countless forces in Daxia who are eyeing it and coveting it.
Therefore, with the passage of time, the remaining power left by Li Taixuan and Tantai Lan gradually weakened. In the past two years, some forces began to spread their fangs against Luo Lan Mansion.
Under this situation, Jiang Qing'e, who was still practicing at Shengxuanxing Academy, had to temporarily take over Luo Lan Mansion. However, although Jiang Qing'e's reputation in Daxia Kingdom has become stronger and stronger in the past two years, she has never stepped into the realm of feudal princes. In terms of strength and deterrence, she is still not as good as it is. Therefore, facing a pack of wolves, she also decisively abandoned some properties of Luo Lan Mansion, intending to use this to gain some time to recover and grow.
This behavior of constantly giving up also makes the outside world think that one of the main reasons why Luo Lan Mansion is in turmoil.
But Li Luo recognized this. After all, he did not have enough strength. If he still occupied Jinshan, it would only cause greater trouble. Suitable forbearance was the long-term solution.
"Although Luo Lan Mansion's momentum has dropped a lot in the past two years, it seems to have stabilized overall, right?" Li Luo asked with some confusion.
Jiang Qing'e pursed her red lips and said calmly: "The external pressure has eased for the time being, but this time, the problem lies within Luo Lan Mansion."
Li Luo's eyes suddenly condensed and he said slowly: "Is that Senior Brother Pei Hao?"
Jiang Qing'e and the mature woman Cai Wei beside them both looked at Li Luo in surprise.
"Although Sister Qing'e has not taken over Luo Lan Mansion for too long, your charm is unparalleled. Now, in Luo Lan Mansion, your prestige is not low. Looking at Luo Lan Mansion, the only one who can resist you is the registered disciple that my parents accepted." Li Luo smiled at their surprised gazes.
Pei Hao was homeless when he was young, and was almost killed because he offended his enemies. Li Luo's parents accidentally rescued him at that time. Seeing how pitiful he was, they took him into the Luo Lan Mansion. After entering the Luo Lan Mansion, he also worked hard and showed good talent, and he got around in the Luo Lan Mansion. So in the end, Li Luo and his parents accepted him as a registered disciple.
After acquiring this identity, Pei Hao's status in the Luo Lan Mansion also rose steadily. By the time Li Luo's parents disappeared, he was already quite powerful in the Luo Lan Mansion.
When his parents were still alive, Senior Brother Pei Hao would come to contact him from time to time, but this contact has decreased a lot in the past two years, especially after the news about Kong Xiang on his side...
From this point of view, this senior brother Pei Hao is quite real.
"Pei Hao has always had objections to me taking charge of the Luo Lan Mansion over the years, and has acted arbitrarily on many of the decisions made in the mansion. His prestige in the Luo Lan Mansion is not low. Nearly half of the nine pavilion masters in the mansion are close to him, which has had a very bad impact." Jiang Qing'e said lightly.
"Actually, if he can contribute to the Luo Lan Mansion, I can endure all this. Even for this so-called position of leadership, if Master and Master hadn't made an appointment before she left, I wouldn't want to step in."
Li Luo nodded. Jiang Qing'e's character actually didn't like these internal matters very much. With her talent, it was most appropriate to concentrate on her practice.
Of course, in the final analysis, it is because he, the young master of the palace, is not very responsible... However, he and Jiang Qing'e both understand that in his current state, this so-called talent of empty phase cannot convince the public at all. If he, the young master of the palace, is really allowed to take charge of Luo Lan Mansion, I am afraid that his father will soon beThe foundation founded by my mother fell apart.
After all, in this world, strength is the basis for convincing people.
"Thank you for your hard work, Sister Qing'e." Li Luo said with sincere gratitude.
Jiang Qing'e shook her head: "No need, after all, you and I have a marriage contract, and I also have a share in this Luo Lan Mansion."
So direct.
Li Luo was speechless, and Cai Wei on the side also covered her lips and smiled, charmingly.
"Since the disappearance of my master and my wife, people in the mansion have been in a state of confusion. Although I tried my best to comfort him, the situation in the Luo Lan mansion can still be seen at a glance. Pei Hao took the opportunity to win over people's hearts and restrain me at every turn. I have conducted investigations before and suspected that there may be other forces secretly helping behind him." Jiang Qing'e continued.
Li Luo stretched out his hand to catch the fallen leaves in front of him and said, "This is... raising a white-eyed wolf."
"Tomorrow Pei Hao will lead his people to Nanfeng City to have a talk with me, but there is a high probability that we can't reach an agreement, and the worst result of not reaching an agreement is that the Luolan Mansion will be directly split. This will be a heavy blow to the current situation of the Luolan Mansion." Jiang Qing'e's golden eyes looked particularly cold at this time, and there was even a faint murderous intention.
Li Luo also frowned. Now Luo Lan Mansion is surrounded by wolves in Daxia. Once it is really divided, the strength of Luo Lan Mansion will be greatly weakened, and it will become more and more troublesome in the future.
But in the end, he could only sigh helplessly, because with his current strength, he could not have any impact on the situation. I am afraid that not many people in the Luo Lan Mansion would look at the so-called Young Master of the Palace. In fact, many people in the mansion had simply forgotten about him as the Young Palace Master.
And all this is because he has no strength and no future.
"Sorry, I can't help you much." Li Luo said.
Jiang Qing'e shook her head and said softly: "Don't worry, even if Luo Lan Mansion is not stable right now, I will definitely make it intact when it is finally handed over to you."
Li Luo didn't say anything, because in fact, he didn't particularly care about it, because no matter how strong the Luo Lan Mansion was, it was still an external object. In this world, only one's own strength is the foundation of everything.
If he could one day enter the princely realm, all problems would be solved.
Next, the two returned to the old house and had dinner together. Jiang Qing'e went straight to work, obviously making some preparations for tomorrow.
And Li Luo didn't bother her. He went to the training room to practice physiognomy for two hours and then went back to the room to rest.
Li Luo didn't sleep for a long time tonight, until after twelve o'clock in the morning, he rolled off the bed and opened today's suitcase from under the bed.
The mysterious black crystal ball was also taken out, and he held it carefully. At this moment, Li Luo could feel that his heartbeat seemed to be beating violently.
"Father, mother, what exactly did you leave me?"
Li Luo gently patted his violently beating heart, and then teased himself to comfort himself.
"It shouldn't really be just a birthday cake that has been stored for several years..."
